fi-osteoglossum-bicirrhosum.title: Silver Arowana
fi-osteoglossum-bicirrhosum.summary: The silver arowana, Osteoglossum bicirrhosum, is a large predator from the Amazon basin, plus river systems in Guyana and French Guiana. Reaching 80 cm, it is largely unsuitable for the home…
rows: Omnivore. This species is a generalised predator with intestinal analyses of wild specimens revealing the natural diet to consist of other fishes, terrestrial insects, aquatic invertebrates and plant material…
Cuvier gave type locality as 'Brazil', with modern records indicating it to range throughout much of the Amazon basin in Brazil, Peru, Colombia and Ecuador , plus the Rupununi and…
notes: Relatively unfussy although some surface cover in the form of floating or overhanging vegetation or branches is appreciated.
It does best if there is a high proportion of dissolved oxygen and moderate degree of water movement so external filters , powerheads, airstones, etc., should be employed as necessary.
